experiences.name: Milford Sound Guided Hike
experiences.description: Explore the stunning Milford Track, one of the world's greatest walks, through ancient rainforest and past dramatic waterfalls. Book a guided day hike to make the most of your time. Since your flight arrives late on Day 1, plan this for Day 2 or later after a proper rest. Arrange accommodation in Te Anau the night before to maximize hiking time.

experiences.name: Nevis Bungy Jump
experiences.description: Experience New Zealand's highest bungy jump at 134 meters above the Nevis River gorge, operated by AJ Hackett. An absolute must for thrill-seekers. Schedule this for mid-trip when you are well-rested and energized. Avoid planning this on Day 1 given the late flight arrival — fatigue and an extreme activity are a risky combination.

experiences.name: Routeburn Track Day Hike
experiences.description: Trek one of New Zealand's Great Walks through alpine meadows, glacial lakes, and mountain passes with breathtaking views of the Southern Alps. A rewarding full-day hike suitable for fit hikers. Plan this after Day 1 rest to ensure you are in peak condition for the terrain.
experiences.location: Routeburn Track, Mount Aspiring National Park

experiences.name: Franz Josef Glacier Hike
experiences.description: Join a guided hike on the famous Franz Josef Glacier, exploring ice caves, seracs, and crevasses with expert guides providing all necessary equipment. A unique glacial experience on the West Coast. This is best placed mid-trip to allow recovery from jet lag and the late Day 1 arrival.

experiences.name: Hanmer Springs Thermal Pools and Forest Walk
experiences.description: Relax in natural thermal pools after days of intense hiking and bungee jumping, then explore the surrounding Hanmer Forest Park trails. A perfect wind-down experience toward the end of your 13-day trip. The thermal pools are especially soothing in the evening, making this ideal for your final days when energy levels may be lower.
